title: SSP-4.4 — Regression, Publication, And Closeout Evidence
summary: record the complete exact-collection regression matrix, one reviewed Analysis publication, durable authority transfer, and parked closeout list
content_html:
SSP-4.4 — Regression, Publication, And Closeout Evidence

Outcome

SSP-4 is complete at its closeout review gate. The one existing Copy workflow now accepts exact parent or configured child collections from both the main Index and default sub-scope selection surfaces, preserves ordinary subject metadata without interpreting it, writes only fresh identities, rebuilds the exact target, and returns exact doc or doc plus subdoc locations. Move remains parent-only and scope-wide Publish remains the sole public mutation.

Regression And Boundary Evidence

  • The 146-test exact-collection matrix passed planner, apply, route, Move-regression, customisation, exact-target, sub-scope build, configuration, capability, and publish-gate checks. It covers all four parent/child source-target shapes, same-parent different-child Copy, retained/omitted/rejected custom metadata, mixed internal/external/local links, media and registered build sources, target defaults, complete stale receipts, provider-neutral storage, contained post-write failures, and parent/child generated follow-through.
  • The shared transfer workflow, main Index selection, default sub-scope report/selection bridge, and managed sub-scope service smokes passed. They retain one modal workflow, server-owned collection eligibility, exact selection ownership, and exact result navigation.
  • A separate 57-test publication/public-boundary run passed checked configuration, scope-wide publish, public runtime imports, public payload shaping, and document-location projection. Analysis Works child and parent builds plus Analysis search were stable with zero warnings and zero writes after acceptance.
  • Explicit changed JavaScript and Python lint, Studio/Docs Viewer/test scope lint, site validation, generated-projection assertions, and repository whitespace validation passed.

Reviewed Publication Acceptance

The reviewed Series copy d-20260807-094819-5712bd retained series_id: "001", its content and eleven copied images, and the authored [[catalogue:series:001|10,000]] snapshot. Manage metadata removed only its explicit viewable: false. The first scope-wide Analysis Publish correctly promoted the child manifest and by-ID payload but exposed that the ordinary Works report host was still non-viewable and therefore absent from the public parent tree.

The existing metadata workflow then made report host d-20260807-082735-54d9d5 viewable while retaining viewer_report_access: public; its lifecycle source revision was refreshed, and the unchanged parent Analysis Publish workflow reported five changed files and zero stale files. The public Analysis tree now contains Works, the public Works manifest contains only the reviewed child, its exact subdoc route loads through the shared public report, all eleven images load, all other copied documents remain absent, and the Series link resolves on the port-4000 public-site origin. A final Publish preview reported zero changed and zero stale files. No Copy action invoked Publish and no publication code or policy changed.

Durable Authority Transfer

  • Create And Import Endpoints now owns exact parent/child request keys, v2 receipt/apply behavior, main/sub-scope surfaces, capability truth, and the parent-only Move boundary.
  • Sub-Scope Customisation Architecture now owns default selection Copy, exact child rebuild/navigation, server-projected destination eligibility, and the public child plus ordinary report-host activation rule.
  • No new reusable checklist rule was established; the existing exact-target, receipt, generated-projection, public-boundary, and focused-verification guardrails remain sufficient.

Independent Review And Omissions

The final bounded diff review found one transfer workflow, one exact collection resolver, one capability projection, existing main/sub-scope selection owners, existing target rebuild owners, and the existing Publish gate. It found no title, filename, route, active-document, displayed-row, or subject fallback; no compatibility alias, second transfer action, literal Projects-to-Analysis branch, overwrite, replacement, lineage persistence, Move expansion, or Copy-to-Publish coupling.

SSP-5 public Work/Series metadata, SSP-6 Project Media Audit, and SSP-7 lineage/Replace/publication-state work remain unstarted.

Roadmap Closeout List

Document set Durable destination Recommendation
Sub-Scope Publishing feature and concept/architecture Continue to own unfinished SSP-5, SSP-6, and SSP-7 routing Retain temporarily
SSP-4 delivery Endpoint and sub-scope architecture documents above Retire only after explicit user approval
SSP-4.0 through SSP-4.4 evidence siblings Durable owners above; Git retains detailed implementation history Retire with SSP-4 only after explicit user approval
Create And Import Endpoints and Sub-Scope Customisation Architecture Current shipped contracts Retain

No document has been retired or deleted. SSP-4 is parked for explicit closeout-list review.
